issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch in the Kakuro exercise: the template class GroverKakuro declares __init__(self, size: int) (expects a size parameter) while the solution implementation defines __init__(self) (no parameter). This discrepancy is structural (constructor contract) and can confuse students about how to instantiate the class or how the exercise is intended to be parameterized (should students supply a size or not?).
issues.suggested_fix: Make the constructor signature consistent across template and solution (and clarify in the problem statement whether a size parameter is required). Either remove the unused size parameter from the template (__init__(self)) so both template and solution match, or update the solution and problem statement to accept and use size: int in the constructor (and document how size affects initialization). Prefer removing the extra parameter in the template if the exercise is fixed to the 2x2 Kakuro instance, or keep the parameter and update the solution to use it if the exercise should support variable sizes.
